mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (measured as the 3-month change in FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances with declining FEDFUNDS, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 7.5% signals an economic slowdown that triggers risk-off sentiment, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 7.5, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0% and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) shows no significant increase (3-month change < 0.1%), the market anticipates a delayed policy response, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a rolling 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion phase (characterized by strong GDP growth but slowing housing starts), the market prices in an imminent economic slowdown, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where the economy is in a late-cycle expansion (as defined by GDPC1 growth > 2.0% and HOUST trend negative), or the regime-specific effect is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 95.0 (index) indicates a contraction in manufacturing activity, triggering short-term equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 95.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rapid payroll growth (PAYEMS) combined with weak retail sales growth (RSAFS) indicates a labor market overheating without corresponding consumer demand, generating recession fears and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05) in a rolling 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in housing starts (measured by the 3-month change in HOUST) signals strengthening consumer confidence and economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances with rising HOUST, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In an inflationary monetary policy regime (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS rising), the market anticipates prolonged high interest rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances in the inflationary monetary policy regime, or the regime-specific effect is not significant (p > 0.05).
